name: Core Pack
desc: The standard chaos pack. One Heel, one Face, one Promo.

cards.title: Lost Luggage
cards.desc: A superstar's gear goes missing. They must compete in generic attire for the next show.

cards.title: Under the Weather
cards.desc: A superstar is ill. They lose their next scheduled match via forfeit.

cards.title: Locker Room Tension
cards.desc: Two superstars refuse to work together. They cannot be in the same tag team this week.

cards.title: Wardrobe Malfunction
cards.desc: A superstar's entrance gear breaks. Change their attire to the most basic available.

cards.title: Medical Suspension
cards.desc: A superstar is pulled from competition. Bench your current champion for 2 shows.

cards.title: Contract Dispute
cards.desc: A superstar demands more money. They refuse to do a clean job for 3 shows.

cards.title: Injury Scare
cards.desc: A superstar picks up a kayfabe injury. They must lose their next match and take 1 show off.

cards.title: Title Scramble Chaos
cards.desc: The title picture is thrown into chaos. Strip the current champion and hold a tournament.

cards.title: Backstage Brawl Gone Wrong
cards.desc: A fight breaks out backstage. Two superstars are suspended for 2 shows each.

cards.title: Brand Split Crisis
cards.desc: A superstar goes rogue and jumps brands without permission. Swap your top star to the opposing brand for a full month.

cards.title: Underdog Push
cards.desc: A mid-card superstar gets a surprise title shot. Book them to win clean.

cards.title: Crowd Favourite Moment
cards.desc: A superstar gets an unexpected crowd reaction. Give them a promo segment this show.

cards.title: Surprise Return
cards.desc: A superstar returns from injury ahead of schedule. Bring back a benched superstar immediately.

cards.title: Viral Moment
cards.desc: A match clip goes viral. The superstar involved gets a 3-show push with wins over ranked opponents.

cards.title: Hot Feud Ignition
cards.desc: Two superstars have undeniable chemistry. Book a best-of-3 series between them.

cards.title: Breakout Performance
cards.desc: A superstar steals the show. Give them a title match at the next PPV.

cards.title: Rocket Push
cards.desc: Management goes all-in on a superstar. They win every match for the next month, clean.

cards.title: Celebrity Crossover
cards.desc: A mainstream celebrity appears at ringside. Book a match with celebrity involvement this show.

cards.title: Legend Returns
cards.desc: A retired legend makes a one-night return. Book them in a match or segment this show.

cards.title: Crowd Chant
cards.desc: The crowd erupts in a spontaneous chant. Pure fan energy.

cards.title: Heated Rivalry
cards.desc: Two superstars exchange words backstage. The tension is palpable.

cards.title: Sports Talk Mention
cards.desc: A wrestling segment gets picked up by a mainstream sports outlet.

cards.title: Electric Promo
cards.desc: A superstar cuts the promo of their career. The crowd is on their feet.

cards.title: Viral Clip
cards.desc: A moment from the show spreads across social media overnight.

cards.title: Attitude Era Energy
cards.desc: The show has that rare, electric quality. Everything clicks tonight.

cards.title: Cultural Moment
cards.desc: Wrestling breaks into the mainstream in a way that hasn't been seen in years.
